user.title: Add room
user.description: Choose thermostat, sensor and window contacts.

data_description.trv: The real thermostat on the radiator.
data_description.temperature_sensor: Used for control instead of the sensor at the radiator.
data_description.window_sensors: If any is open, heating is paused.

data.off_method: How to switch the TRV off

data_description.calibration_mode: Offset: the TRV continuously gets a correction value so it 'sees' the room temperature (recommended). Setpoint: the TRV setpoint is adjusted – for TRVs without offset.
data_description.off_method: Auto picks the right method. Tuya TRVs: usually 'preset off'.
data_description.on_preset: The TRV must regulate to the sent setpoint in this preset. Auto picks e.g. 'eco' and avoids 'on' – on the TRV602Z 'on' means valve permanently open.

data.offset_threshold: Send offset only if change is at least
data.follow_trv_changes: Adopt changes made on the TRV
data.notify_on_failure: Notify if the TRV does not respond

data_description.sync_verify_delay: Then it is checked whether the TRV applied the command; otherwise it is repeated with growing intervals. Helps with short connection drops.
data_description.follow_trv_changes: Off: changes on the device are reverted (like a child lock).
data_description.sensor_stale_minutes: Afterwards the TRV uses its own sensor and the status shows a warning.

data_description.room_type: Sets sensible defaults; fine-tune later with the device's number controls.
data_description.comfort_temperature: Empty = room type default. Used on first start and when switching on a room that was off.
data_description.weather_entity: Used for recommended airing time and whether airing actually dries the room.
data_description.notify_targets: e.g. notify.mobile_app_… — iOS messages get action buttons.
data_description.tts_targets: Announcement only when the room cools down or after repeated reminders, never in quiet hours.
data_description.quiet_start: Silent push only during quiet hours.

error.calibration_entity_required: The offset calibration type needs a calibration entity.

abort.already_configured: This thermostat is already assigned to a room.
